tool_args.prompt: Generate ONE complete static RGBA character image of the normal cloth-hood Executioner Majini from Resident Evil 5 (2009). Reference1 is the complete equipped original-edition character and authority for the hand assignment and axe. Reference2 is a RIGHT-FACING PROFILE of the actual native PC body model without an axe; reference3 is its back and reference4 its front. Use the native model for body proportions, rear straps and boots, and reference1 for the complete chained serrated axe and weathered costume. The NEW stance must face SCREEN RIGHT in an almost pure SIDE PROFILE, like reference2, with only a little front or back depth; the chest is narrow in projection. Critical arm arrangement: the NEAR ARM is his ANATOMICAL RIGHT ARM. Extend that near right arm FORWARD diagonally toward SCREEN RIGHT, elbow well ahead of the torso, so the RIGHT HAND holds the shaft immediately behind the AXE HEAD. Fold the FAR ANATOMICAL LEFT ARM back toward his waist, so the LEFT HAND grips the REAR BUTT of the shaft at SCREEN LEFT. The far left elbow stays nearer the waist and its wrist ends at the left end of the shaft. There are only two arms and two hands. Do not put the near hand on the rear butt. Do not cross the wrists or merely exchange hand textures. Both hands physically enclose the wooden shaft with correct wrists. Keep all source cloth hood pins, shoulder stitches, long arm wraps, heavy ragged apron, and rear hooks. Feet and trouser surfaces may be shown only as documented in the native body references. The axe projects horizontally forward to screen RIGHT, complete serrations and every chain visible. Make the COMPLETE character AND entire axe fit inside the image with at least 10 percent transparent breathing room on every side; scale everything down together to achieve this. One static textured survival-horror game character only. No mirror, frontal-chest repetition, duplicated limb, flaming axe, leather hood, additional injury, background, floor, shadow panel, glow, text or border. This is one generated adaptation for visual review, not original animation or certified geometry.
